issues.issue: [fixed] The report shows what budgetary 'Miscellaneous' is made of. The combined General Fund schedule (p5) prints Miscellaneous 457,880, which equals Interest on taxes 2,643 + Interest on investments 144,893 + State grants and aid 310,344 on p4. State aid is 68% of that, so under the rules this line should be intergovernmental/state aid (detail 'other state aid'), with review naming the interest mix, not other/miscellaneous revenue.

[fixed] Same as detail[2]: Ambulance 'Miscellaneous' is part of the p5 Miscellaneous 457,880 (state grants and aid plus interest per p4). It should be intergovernmental/state aid (detail 'other state aid') with review, not other.

issues.issue: All six detail_totals use fund 'General - Fire' / 'General - Ambulance', but the detail items use fund 'General'. validate.py matches on (fund, schedule, section), so it will silently skip these tie-outs. I checked them by hand and they tie: Fire revenue 3,615,302, expenditures 3,710,085, transfers (158,522); Ambulance revenue 2,312,066, expenditures 2,423,604, transfers 158,522.

The sub-schedules on pp6-7 differ from the combined schedule on p5 by $1 on each revenue line (property taxes 5,458,947 vs 5,458,948; other taxes 10,542 vs 10,543; miscellaneous 457,879 vs 457,880), $3 in total. This is rounding printed in the report. Expenditures tie (6,133,689).
